title: Launchpad Spark: Modular hero microflow + progressive compact steps visual refresh
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refresh the quickstart landing hero and initial step visuals with a modular 'Launchpad Spark' system: a microflow-centred hero that reveals progressive compact steps beneath, plus a deterministic screenshot pipeline for release assets. The goal is to reduce cognitive load for new engineers while providing screenshots and assets that scale across docs, marketing, and in-app quickstarts. Deliver a Figma component kit, exported device-frame screenshots, and a short motion prototype for handoff to frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Hero microflow component implemented as a responsive Figma component with defined breakpoints and tokens
Three step-card states (initial, active, completed) defined with accessible contrast and microcopy variants
Automated export pipeline documented enabling PNG/JPG/AVIF outputs for 3 device sizes
Design tokens and color overlays documented for product and marketing usage
Motion prototype (2–3s loop) available and linked in the ticket
Hand-off checklist completed and design review approved by PM and Eng
design_notes: Key idea: make the hero feel instructional rather than promotional. Use a microflow metaphor (spark -> pipeline -> outcome) with a central illustrative frame and three compact step tiles beneath that expand on hover. Prioritize tokenized screenshot overlays so product screenshots can be swapped programmatically for localization and A/B variants. Provide an accessibility pass: test color overlays at 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for larger labels. Keep copy short (6–9 words per step) and include optional secondary microcopy for advanced users.
decisions: Use a modular Figma component with auto-layout so hero can scale from 320px to 1440px
Adopt a 3-step progressive pattern instead of 4 to simplify cognitive load
Apply a semi-opaque single-color overlay on device screenshots to ensure CTA text legibility
Provide both static exported assets and a short Lottie prototype for animations
tasks: Create Figma component library: hero-microflow, step-cards, device-frames
Build screenshot export presets: phone/desktop/tablet with 2x DPR
Design microcopy variants (concise / expanded) and submit to UX writing
Run accessibility contrast checks and update palette tokens
Create motion prototype in Principle and export Lottie
Prepare handoff doc (confluence link) and update frontend acceptance criteria
